upstream.licenseFile: Original complete EPL2.0 text is retained without relabeling it Apache2.0. Upstream runs separately and is not bundled into the production core.

frozenOptions.transaction-order: ABSENT; this option means a numeric total transaction order, not arbitrary per-key chains

graphGate: Assert elle.txn/additional-graphs returns no automatically selected graph with these exact options. Empty additional-graphs alone would not suppress strict-serializable's default realtime/process inference.

commonInput.schema: Existing original traceSchema3 point-register-v1 or append-list-v1 observations; no normalized report, inferred chain, graph or witness is used as checker input.
commonInput.lifecycle: Exactly one consistent first snapshot, complete exclusive writer scope, sequential seq/time, begin/read/write-or-append/list_read/commit_request/commit_ok only; all transactions committed. Scope SQL/predicates/aborts/unknown outcomes/savepoints are outside this first common range, not silently flattened.
commonInput.register: At most one actual write per key across the original history. Rename each captured per-key initial version to Elle nil; keep every noninitial version identity. No initializer transaction is invented. More than one write per key is outside the first shared graph range even if this tool could infer or search an order.
commonInput.list: Every captured initial list must be empty. Keep append identity, key and exact order. Confirm each known identity's string business payload against its original producer before projecting its identity as the Elle element; repeated business values remain allowed. Nonempty initial state or unknown/content-mismatched producers is not converted into fabricated appends.
commonInput.sources: A read source must have been captured by its observation; no later producer fills a permanent missing source. Read observations and actual successful operations retain transaction order. A predecessor is metadata and never becomes an invented read.
commonInput.invocations: Emit one invoke and one ok for each real transaction at its actual begin/commit acknowledgement positions; invocation reads use unobserved nil placeholders, completion reads contain the captured observations. Dense checker indices only encode the preserved event subsequence; preserve original seq mappings separately.
prohibited: search-completed order as a captured fact
classification inferred from our own rewritten Elle rules

dependencies.profiles: Run upstream with -dev and a new LEIN_HOME; no project source edits or added classifier dependency.
dependencies.artifactGate: Record actual Java/Lein/Clojure versions, dependency tree and every resolved JAR/POM SHA before accepting an execution receipt. Maven dependency resolution failures are setup failures, not checker outcomes. Transitive runtime hashes are pending first actual remote resolution.

resultPolicy.raw: Keep full untouched Elle result as EDN plus original input/converted operation/source bindings; exceptions and timeouts are not valid histories.
resultPolicy.unknown: Preserve :valid? :unknown and cycle-search-timeout/empty-transaction-graph. In particular, an edgeless transaction graph is an explicit coverage difference even when this tool finds a serial execution.
resultPolicy.comparisons: Positive and negative common examples must agree with their preregistered theoretical expectations and the independently run MoonBit report. An unsupported adapter input is not submitted to Elle and is not counted as a checker pass.
resultPolicy.failure: Retain every mismatch, raw negative result and first run; never tune converter/output expectations from actual results.
resultPolicy.expansion: Only after actual small smoke works, preregister and freeze 1000 distinct register plus 1000 append raw histories. Unknown and outside-range cases remain separately counted; this first serializable profile does not establish six-model parity or arbitrary SQL coverage.
